findings.title: The saw_crisis_active latch conjunct is dominated by the live crisis check in the dots_during_crisis increment
findings.evidence: if stats.saw_crisis_active && len(s.crisis.active) > 0 do stats.dots_during_crisis += 1 — the gate (:392) keys on crises >= 1, never the latch
findings.detail: The event walk reads post-step state, so a trigger-tick dot sees active > 0 regardless of in-walk order; the latch adds nothing to the increment and is read nowhere else. Harmless dead instrumentation (the r4 false-fail is nonetheless genuinely fixed).
findings.recommended_fix: Drop the latch (field + both writes) or key the gate on it — one voice.
